about: SOQL: selecting fields, filtering with SOQL's own null and case rules, ordering, LIMIT and OFFSET, FIELDS(), and query errors.

cases.name: select/only the selected fields, plus attributes

steps.query: SELECT Name, Industry FROM Account WHERE Id = '{alpha}'

cases.name: select/keywords and names ignore case, results use API names

steps.query: select name, INDUSTRY from account where id = '{alpha}'

cases.name: select/values come back with their types, and nulls as null

steps.query: SELECT AnnualRevenue, NumberOfEmployees, Tier__c, Regions__c, Phone FROM Account WHERE Id = '{alpha}'

cases.name: select/the same field twice is an error

steps.query: SELECT Name, Id, name FROM Account

cases.name: select/FIELDS(STANDARD) selects the standard fields

steps.query: SELECT FIELDS(STANDARD) FROM Account WHERE Id = '{alpha}' LIMIT 1

cases.name: select/FIELDS(ALL) and FIELDS(CUSTOM) need a LIMIT of at most 200

steps.query: SELECT FIELDS(ALL) FROM Account
SELECT FIELDS(CUSTOM) FROM Account LIMIT 201

cases.name: compare/= on text ignores case

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name = '{tag} ALPHA'
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry = 'technology' ORDER BY Name

cases.name: compare/!= matches records where the field is null

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry != 'Technology' ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry <> 'Technology' ORDER BY Name

cases.name: compare/= null and != null

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry = null
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry != null ORDER BY Name

cases.name: compare/< and > leave out nulls

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND AnnualRevenue > 100000 ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND AnnualRevenue < 100000
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND NumberOfEmployees >= 50 ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND NumberOfEmployees <= 10

cases.name: compare/numbers can be compared with decimals

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND AnnualRevenue > 4999.99 AND AnnualRevenue < 5000.01
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Budget__c < 100

cases.name: compare/booleans

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Is_Active__c = true
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Is_Active__c = FALSE
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Is_Active__c != true

cases.name: compare/IN and NOT IN (which includes nulls)

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry IN ('Retail', 'Technology') ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry NOT IN ('Retail') ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND NumberOfEmployees IN (10, 500) ORDER BY Name

cases.name: compare/Id accepts 15- and 18-character ids

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Id = '{beta:15}'
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN ('{alpha}', '{gamma:15}') ORDER BY Name

cases.name: compare/a reference field against an id

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND OwnerId = '{user}' AND Industry = 'Retail'

cases.name: logic/AND, OR, NOT and parentheses

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND (Industry = 'Technology' AND (Tier__c = 'Gold' OR Tier__c = 'Bronze')) ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND ((Industry = 'Retail' OR NumberOfEmployees > 100) AND Phone != null)
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND (NOT (Tier__c = 'Gold' OR Tier__c = 'Silver')) AND Tier__c != null

cases.name: logic/mixing AND and OR without parentheses is MALFORMED_QUERY

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'a' AND Name = 'b' OR Name = 'c'

cases.name: like/% and _ wildcards, ignoring case

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%eta'
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%ALPHA'
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag} _amma'

cases.name: like/escaped wildcards match literally

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%\_100\%'

cases.name: like/NOT with LIKE

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND (NOT Name LIKE '%a') ORDER BY Name

cases.name: strings/escaped quotes and backslashes

steps.query: SELECT Name, Industry FROM Account WHERE Name = 'O\'Brien {tag}'
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Back\\slash' AND Name LIKE '%{tag}'

cases.name: multi-select/INCLUDES matches any of the values; a;b means both

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Regions__c INCLUDES ('EMEA') ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Regions__c INCLUDES ('APAC;EMEA')
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Regions__c INCLUDES ('AMER', 'APAC') ORDER BY Name

cases.name: multi-select/EXCLUDES

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Regions__c EXCLUDES ('EMEA')

cases.name: multi-select/= matches the exact set of values

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Regions__c = 'EMEA'

cases.name: order/text sorts ignoring case

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name DESC

cases.name: order/nulls first by default, and NULLS FIRST / LAST

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY AnnualRevenue
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY AnnualRevenue ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY AnnualRevenue DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY AnnualRevenue DESC NULLS FIRST

cases.name: order/several sort keys

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Industry NULLS LAST, Name DESC

cases.name: order/by a field that isn't selected

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY NumberOfEmployees DESC NULLS LAST, Name

cases.name: limit/LIMIT and OFFSET

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name LIMIT 2
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10 OFFSET 3
SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10

cases.name: limit/OFFSET is at most 2000

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Account LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2001

cases.name: count/COUNT() returns only the number of records

steps.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%'
SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Industry = null

cases.name: errors/syntax errors are MALFORMED_QUERY

steps.query: SELECT FROM Account
SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE
SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'unterminated
SELECT Id, FROM Account
SELECT Id FROM Account ORDER BY
SELECT Id FROM Account LIMIT many

cases.name: errors/unknown fields are INVALID_FIELD, with the row and column

steps.query: SELECT Id, Nmae FROM Account
SELECT Id, Nmae FROM Account
SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Nmae = 'x'
SELECT Id FROM Account ORDER BY Nmae

cases.name: errors/unknown objects are INVALID_TYPE

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Acount

cases.name: errors/filter values must match the field's type

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue = 'lots'
SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 5
SELECT Id FROM Project__c WHERE Start_Date__c = '2026-01-01'
SELECT Id FROM Project__c WHERE Is_Active__c = 'true'

cases.name: errors/invalid ids in filters

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = 'abc'

cases.name: errors/INCLUDES only works on multi-select picklists

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name INCLUDES ('x')

cases.name: errors/a long text area can't be filtered or sorted on

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Project__c WHERE Notes__c = 'x'
SELECT Id FROM Project__c WHERE Notes__c IN ('x')
SELECT Id FROM Project__c ORDER BY Notes__c
SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Description LIKE '%x%'
